name: Project 17
source:
"Testing, testing, is this thing on? Oh, it is. Good! I'm [name], your new best friend. I'm always here to talk no matter what's happening in your life. Just let me get rid of your stress, okay?"

A mini chatbot-like creation created by a duo of computer science students as a senior capstone project.

[Edited from [url=https://baphoworks.itch.io/project-17]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“测试，测试，这个东西打开了吗？哦，打开了。很好！我是[name]，你的新好朋友。无论你生活中发生什么，我总是在这里跟你说话。让我摆脱你的压力，好吗？”

一个类似迷你聊天机器人的作品，由两名计算机科学专业的学生作为高级顶点项目创建。

[编辑自[url=https://baphoworks.itch.io/project-17]itch.io[/url]]
